dedupe_keys.name: lyon festival of lights dense crowd trajectory observations

description: The MADRAS crowd dynamics team publishes pedestrian observations from the 2022 Festival of Lights in Lyon through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. The article describes macroscopic flows, individual trajectories, GPS traces, contacts, interaction statistics and a visitor survey, with square geometry and temporary obstacles in CSV or WKT form. These records can calibrate dense-crowd movement or evacuation simulations in public spaces. Coverage is one festival event with unusual crowd management, lighting and visitor composition. A caveat is that trajectories at different scales and survey responses have distinct sampling methods and should not be merged as if each were a complete census. Temporary barriers should be preserved when reconstructing walking space. The project also provides a separate online explorer. I read the own Zenodo metadata and article Data Records without downloading the archive, tracking individuals or fitting a pedestrian model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
